ALDER PEAK ROBOTICS, INC.
2025 STOCK OPTION PLAN
BOARD RESOLUTION AND OPTION GRANT

Optionee: Jordan Vale
Date of Grant: March 10, 2027
Vesting Commencement Date: March 1, 2027
The Board of Directors approved this grant on March 10, 2027.
The Company grants the Optionee an option to purchase 30,000 shares of Common Stock at an exercise price of $2.10 per share under the 2025 Stock Option Plan.
The option vests over 48 months with a 12 month cliff.
Type of Option: Non-Qualified Stock Option
